newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine peso ends day untraded due to floods.
newsitem.headline: Philippine peso ends day untraded due to floods.

text.p: The Philippine peso was untraded on Monday after floods crippled business in the capital.
The Bankers Association of the Philippines (BAP) said earlier trades in the Philippine peso/U.S. dollar were up to the discretion of banks.
Earlier, money market trades were suspended after the BAP decided not clear cheques due to bad weather conditions.
The peso closed unchanged from Friday's 26.375 to the dollar.
